name: Sautéd Fillets of Beef with Stuffed Mushroom Caps
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: strips of red and green pepper
ingredients.originalText: strips of red and green pepper

instructions.text: Prepare and cook six fillets same as Sautéd Fillets of Beef à la Moelle.
Put a sautéd stuffed mushroom cap on each, sprinkle with buttered crumbs, and bake until crumbs are browned.
Clean and finely chop six mushroom caps; add one tablespoon each of parsley and onion finely chopped, and one tablespoon butter.
Remove to serving dish, pour around Espagnole Sauce, and garnish caps with strips of red and green pepper cut in fancy shapes.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Prepare and cook six fillets same as Sautéd Fillets of Beef à la Moelle.
2. Put a sautéd stuffed mushroom cap on each, sprinkle with buttered crumbs, and bake until crumbs are browned.
3. Clean and finely chop six mushroom caps; add one tablespoon each of parsley and onion finely chopped, and one tablespoon butter.
4. Moisten with Espagnole Sauce.
5. Remove to serving dish, pour around Espagnole Sauce, and garnish caps with strips of red and green pepper cut in fancy shapes.
